subject: reasoning
question: If X is the sister of Y, Z is the father of A and Y is the son of A, then how is Z related to X?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) X is the sister of Y

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b498025e05928d5283b2c63a3ed528f8cab54d805841dce0ebea43049a3dd0fc.png] 

2) Z is the father of A and Y is the son of A 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e1bbf1510b7d5f1dedfc04e7ccbc083d1460eec69dd847c05637e26c1df01f0.png] 

Thus, Z is X's grandfather.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
